name: How long does a typical door jamb repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical door jamb repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a door jamb repair depends on the severity of the damage and the type of door jamb. Minor repairs, such as filling small holes or cracks, might take a few hours. More extensive damage, like replacing a significant section due to rot or impact, could require a full day or more. We aim to complete repairs efficiently while ensuring high-quality results, minimizing disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair times vary from a few hours for minor issues to a full day or more for extensive damage, depending on the severity.
